P.name: Dragon Practice
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Smolder''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}, or whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. His basic abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
* ''{{ai|Q|Smolder}}'': Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 55|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|W|Smolder}}'': Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|E|Smolder}}'': Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 12.8|0 to 4.8|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.

Q.name: Super Scorcher Breath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 75|critScaling=true}}; applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' kills at least one target, '''Smolder''' restores {{sti|{{as|15 mana}}}}.
Q.description2: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
Q.description3: {{sbc|Tier 1 - 25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Tier 2 - 125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth 2 {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}} per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts of fire in an arc upon collision that explode at maximum range, dealing {{ap|0.5*100}}% of the same damage to enemies hit. The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Tier 3 - 225 stacks:}} Enemies hit are set on fire for 3 seconds, causing them to take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at 300 against monsters.|{{as|{{ap|2.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as| of their '''maximum''' health}} each second, capped at {{ap|300/3}} per tick against monsters.}}Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn. Enemy {{tip|champions}} afflicted with the burn are also {{tip|execute|executed}} once '''Smolder''' deals damage to them that would leave them below {{as|{{fd|6.5}}% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
Q.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Smolder's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Smolder|as_base}})*{{ccd|Smolder|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Achooo!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' sneezes a fiery glob in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 35% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, slowing down in missile speed after travelling {{tt|1200|estimated}} units. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, with subsequent explosions against the same target dealing 75% damage of the previous explosion's damage.

E.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' takes flight for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|unobstructed vision}}, and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires up to 5 {{as|(+ 1 per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts at the nearest and {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit and prioritizing enemy champions.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|10*5 to 30*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AD)}}}}
E.description2: ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' ends immediately if '''Smolder''' casts another ability or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.

R.name: MMOOOMMMM!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' shouts for his mother to attack from above, causing her to exhale a wave of fire starting from behind him and towards the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the center part goes through that brush}} as it travels. The wave {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Smolder''' and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, with those in the center taking {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} and becoming {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% for 2 seconds.
